_comment: Downstream org-config skeleton (ADR-0006). Replace every YOUR_ORG placeholder with this org's GitHub login, then remove this _comment key. `config_dir: otterdog` keeps all config under otterdog/<org>/. The env credential provider reads the App installation token from OTTERDOG_TOKEN (minted by the reusable workflow); the dummy web-cred keys satisfy otterdog's env provider on the --no-web-ui path and are never exercised.
